extDescription.message: Tells you when a site sells people's information, and lets the Free My ID app ask them to remove you.
extDescription.description: Store and add-ons page description. 132 characters at most.

bannerLabel.description: Screen-reader name of the banner shown on a people-search site.

bannerText.message: This site sells people's information. Free My ID can ask them to remove you.
bannerText.description: Main banner sentence. Keep it calm and short.

bannerRemove.description: Banner button: start a removal request for this site.

bannerNotNow.description: Banner button: hide the banner on this site for a while.

bannerClose.description: Banner button shown after the person pressed Remove me.

bannerWorking.message: Telling the Free My ID app...
bannerWorking.description: Shown while the extension talks to the app on this computer.

bannerStarted.message: The Free My ID app has it from here. This covers this site only, and listings can come back, so the app keeps checking.
bannerStarted.description: Shown when the app accepted the request. Must stay honest: one site only, listings can return.

bannerNoApp.message: The Free My ID app did not answer. Open Free My ID on this computer and try again.
bannerNoApp.description: Shown when the app is not installed, not set up, or not reachable.

bannerNotReady.message: This button is not ready yet. Please open the Free My ID app and start the removal there.
bannerNotReady.description: Shown when the app answered but cannot start the removal from the browser.

popupAppLabel.description: Row label: is the desktop app reachable.

popupAppNotConnected.message: Not connected. Open Free My ID on this computer.
popupAppNotConnected.description: The desktop app did not answer.

popupSiteLabel.description: Row label: is the site in the current tab a known broker.

popupSiteBroker.message: $NAME$ is on our list of companies that sell people's information.
popupSiteBroker.description: The current site is a known broker.

popupSiteNotBroker.message: Not on our list. That does not mean it is safe; our list is not complete.
popupSiteNotBroker.description: The current site is not in the bundled list.

popupSiteUnknown.description: The current tab is not a normal web page.

popupStateLabel.description: Row label: listing state for this broker, as the desktop app knows it.

popupRemove.description: Popup button: start a removal request for this site.

popupOptions.description: Popup button: open the options page.

popupPrivacy.message: This add-on sends nothing over the internet. It only talks to the Free My ID app on this computer.
popupPrivacy.description: Short privacy line at the bottom of the popup.

state_unknown.message: Not checked yet. Open the Free My ID app to check.

state_not_found.message: No listing found the last time the app looked.

state_found.message: A listing was found. No request sent yet.

state_submitted.message: Removal request sent. Waiting for the site.

state_awaiting_verification.message: The site wants a confirmation. The app is waiting for it.

state_confirmed.message: The site says it got the request. The app will check again later.

state_removed.message: Removed from this site. Other sites are separate, and listings can come back.
state_removed.description: Listing state. Must stay honest: removed means from this site only.

state_reappeared.message: The listing came back. The app will ask again.

state_needs_human.message: Needs you. Open the Free My ID app to see the next step.
state_needs_human.description: Listing state: a person has to do a step.

state_error.message: Something went wrong. Open the Free My ID app to see more.

optionsBannerLabel.message: Show a message when I visit a site that sells people's information
optionsBannerLabel.description: Checkbox label on the options page.

optionsForget.message: Forget the sites where I chose "Not now"

optionsForgetHint.message: When you choose "Not now", the message stays hidden on that site for 30 days. This is remembered on this computer only.

optionsForgotten.message: Done. The message can show again on those sites.
optionsForgotten.description: Shown after the forget button was pressed.

optionsGpcTitle.message: Tell websites not to sell or share my information
optionsGpcTitle.description: Heading of the Global Privacy Control section on the options page.

optionsGpcLabel.message: Send the Global Privacy Control signal to every website I visit

optionsGpcHint.message: This is a standard "do not sell or share" message. Some state laws make websites honor it; in other places a site may ignore it. It does not remove a listing. This setting is new and still being tested.
optionsGpcHint.description: Honest limits of the signal. Do not promise that sites obey it.

optionsGpcPermission.message: When you turn this on, your browser will ask if Free My ID may "read and change your data on all websites". That is the browser's wording for any add-on that adds something to what your browser sends. Free My ID adds this one message and does not read your pages.
optionsGpcPermission.description: Explains the browser permission question before it appears.

optionsGpcOn.message: On. Your browser now sends the signal.
optionsGpcOn.description: Shown after the signal was switched on.

optionsGpcOff.message: Off. The signal is no longer sent.
optionsGpcOff.description: Shown after the signal was switched off.

optionsGpcDeclined.message: Not turned on. Your browser did not give permission, or could not switch it on. Nothing was changed.
optionsGpcDeclined.description: Shown when the person or the browser said no to the permission question, or a step failed after a yes and everything was switched off again.

optionsGpcStillOn.message: Still on. Your browser could not switch it off. Please try again.
optionsGpcStillOn.description: Shown when switching the signal off failed and the browser reports it is still on.

optionsGpcAlready.message: Your browser already sends this signal. There is nothing to turn on here.
optionsGpcAlready.description: Shown when the browser itself sends GPC (Firefox or Brave with the setting on).

optionsGpcBrowser.message: This browser has its own switch for this. In Firefox: open Settings, choose Privacy & Security, and tick "Tell websites not to sell or share my data".
optionsGpcBrowser.description: Shown in browsers where the extension does not send GPC itself.

optionsPrivacyTitle.message: What this add-on does and does not do
optionsPrivacyTitle.description: Heading of the privacy list on the options page.

optionsPrivacy1.message: It sends nothing over the internet. No tracking, no statistics, no account.

optionsPrivacy2.message: It only talks to the Free My ID app on this computer. Your name and other details stay in the app; they are never given to this add-on.

optionsPrivacy3.message: On the sites in its list it looks at the site's address only. It does not read the page. On other sites it does nothing, unless you turn on the "do not sell or share" signal above, which only adds that signal.

optionsPrivacy4.message: It never fills in or clicks through "I am not a robot" checks. Those are always yours to do.

optionsPrivacy5.message: Some sites need steps only you can do, and a removed listing can come back. "Removed" always means removed from that one site.
optionsPrivacy5.description: Privacy list item: honesty about limits.

bannerFill.message: Fill in the form for me
bannerFill.description: Banner button: fill this site's removal form with the details the person allowed.

bannerFillWorking.message: Asking the Free My ID app what to fill in...
bannerFillWorking.description: Shown while the app decides which boxes to fill.

bannerFilled.message: Free My ID filled in $COUNT$ boxes. Please check them. If the site asks you to prove you are not a robot, do that step yourself, then press the site's own button to send the form.
bannerFilled.description: After filling. Must say: check, the person does any robot check and presses Submit.

bannerFillNothing.message: Free My ID did not find boxes on this page it may fill in. Open the site's removal form and try again, or use the steps in the Free My ID app.

bannerFillOpenApp.message: Please open the Free My ID app on this computer, then press the button again. Your details stay locked inside the app until it is open.
bannerFillOpenApp.description: The app window is closed, so it cannot read the person's details.

bannerFillChoosePerson.message: Free My ID looks after more than one person on this computer. Please open the app and use Fill it in for me on the right person's card.
bannerFillChoosePerson.description: Several people could be meant; the extension never shows names.

bannerFillNotPaired.message: This browser is not connected to the Free My ID app yet. Click the Free My ID button in the toolbar and choose Connect to the app.
bannerFillNotPaired.description: The extension has not been paired with the app.

bannerFillNoPermission.message: Free My ID needs your permission first. Please open the app and finish the setup.
bannerFillNoPermission.description: No person has given consent in the app yet.

bannerFillFailed.message: That did not work. Please use the steps in the Free My ID app instead.

popupAppNotPaired.description: The app answered, but this browser is not paired with it.

popupPairIntro.message: Connect this browser to the Free My ID app on this computer, so it can start removals and fill in forms for you.

popupPair.description: Popup button: start pairing with the desktop app.

popupPairCode.message: Your code is $CODE$. In the Free My ID app, open Settings, then Browser helper, and confirm this same code. The code works for 10 minutes.
popupPairCode.description: Shows the pairing code to confirm in the app.

popupPairFailed.message: The Free My ID app did not give a code. Open Free My ID on this computer and try again.

popupFill.message: Fill in the form for me
popupFill.description: Popup button: fill this broker's form.
